The notices cloud providers send about the agency's own estate (Azure Service Health, the Microsoft 365 Message center, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure announcements, AWS Health and Google Cloud): turning every notice into one record, routing it to an owner as a Ticket-to-Machine task, and keeping the weekly digest and its evidence.

Work down the page: understand the design, plan it, build it, learn it, watch it, download it, and keep the evidence. [All topics](index.md) lists the others.
